thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate on model variant beta3-quant in us-west. error-rate ~18% over last 5m. auto-threshold triggered. link: https://internal/redwood/incidents/2745001234
emily.s: ack, picking this up. oncall here. gathering metrics, paging SRE.
emily.s: @raj_k can you join? seeing increased customer errors + latency on text-generation route.
raj_k: on it, joining. pulling logs now. are we seeing KV-cache misses after recent rollout?
lina_ops: adding context: deploy-bot shows last promotion of beta3-quant at 2744999000, traffic weight 30%.
raj_k: confirmed spike aligns with that. top errors are OOM-infer and kernel-timeouts from a subset of hosts.
emily.s: impact: ~12% of production traffic failing, several customers reported elevated error rates to support. ben_product, heads-up for potential customer comms.
ben_product: thx. please post ETA for mitigation once you have it. priority on avoiding customer-visible 5xx.
raj_k: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily disable beta3-quant variant routing, 2) rehome traffic to stable-2024-09 (compatible), 3) apply short key-level soft throttles for top noisy keys while capacity stabilizes.
emily.s: agree. execute step 1 now to limit customer impact.
raj_k: running disable command: ```infractl variant disable --name beta3-quant --reason "emergency 5xx" --force```
deploy-bot: variant beta3-quant marked INACTIVE by raj_k at 2745001240. routing policy re-evaluating.
raj_k: steering traffic to stable-2024-09, initiating weighted migrate: 30% -> 100% over 30s.
emily.s: initiating key-slice soft throttle: reduce qps by 50% for top 5 heavy keys to prevent cascading pressure. command: ```routerctl limit --keys key123,key456,key789 --qps 50% --duration 10m```
support-bot: noted affected customers: cust-alpha, cust-delta, cust-gamma — support tickets opened.
lina_ops: watching infra metrics. CPU and memory on stable nodes spiked briefly but within headroom. error-rate down to 2.1% in 60s.
raj_k: latency normalized, 5xx back to baseline. verifying no error regressions in traces.
emily.s: can we confirm KV-cache warmup? anything to prevent future cache-thrash?
raj_k: enabling prefix-KV warmup for stable-2024-09 on us-west. command: ```runtimectl cache-warm --model stable-2024-09 --region us-west --prefetch 50k```
ben_product: appreciate the quick action. forwarding summary to ops@ and PG for comms.
emily.s: creating incident record and will schedule a postmortem. tagging owners: @raj_k (SRE), @lina_ops (infra), @ben_product (prod).
raj_k: note: we'll keep beta3-quant disabled until we run a repro and fix kernel-timeout root cause. planning a controlled canary after patch.
lina_ops: adding an emergency quota: increase capacity buffer on stable pool by 15% to handle spillover for next 24h.
emily.s: final status: traffic fully shifted to stable-2024-09, beta3-quant disabled, top noisy keys soft-throttled (auto unfreeze in 10m), customer impact mitigated. closing pager.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: root cause pending investigation. severity: Sev2. follow-up: postmortem link will be provided when ready. :white_check_mark:
